description: Agent evaluation prompts for the Bonafoid MCP server. Score each run on valid == true, tool-call count and zero raw-XML authoring calls.

prompts.prompt: Build a simple invoice approval workflow: start, a manager reviews it, then end.
Create a contract workflow where two departments sign in parallel and both branches end.
Model a support ticket that starts on a timer, waits for an agent, and ends. Declare the timer definition.
Build a workflow that starts, calls an HTTP service notification, then ends.
Build a review loop: submit, decide, loop back for another review when rejected, otherwise end.
